utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Tuesday the seventeenth. Everyone on? Teams is doing that thing where half the faces have disappeared.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid. Spent ten minutes looking at the same drain cover.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Interesting bit of infrastructure, though. You'd appreciate it more if you weren't moving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Speaking of moving, whose new car is that in the car park? Taking up a fairly generous amount of it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one worth less than the tyres on that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, was I muted? I've been saying morning to myself.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've got you now.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Before we get going, the charity bake sale on Friday — last year's flapjack nearly took a filling out. Still ate three bits, mind.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's not flapjack, that's a composite material.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a materials review. Couple of closed items first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the line one on Tuesday — that's this morning's sign-off. Done, not another inspection to allocate.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's closed. Nothing outstanding from that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we finished the repair on the stretch wrapper last night. That's finished work as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. Nice to have something in the finished column for once.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, separate observation: heard a slight rattle from the line 1, nothing to action yet. Just mentioning what I heard, not asking for a job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only, no new work off that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me. Noticed the fire panel was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Nothing ongoing to report.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, settled down. That's context, then, not a fresh action from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: The other thing is the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 2 robot. Still blocked, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no confirmation. Same position as before, not a new chase I'm taking on here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, that stays blocked. We're not allocating any new work against it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We do need someone to go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine two water valve.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine two water valve today at 2pm. And yeah, that one's safety critical, straight away — it goes ahead of the low-priority stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. Today at 2pm is the pickup, and we're treating that as safety critical, straight away. Not something to leave floating.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, agreed. I'll do that pickup at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you — water valve parts, not the gas valve order? Just keeping the two straight in my head.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Water, yeah. My pickup is the replacement parts for the turbine two water valve.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one gas valve by end of day. That one's fairly important. Separate thing from the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie. Purchase order chase for the turbine one gas valve, fairly important, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. The chase, not a promise that the parts will land.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you grease and check the bearings on the turbine two? Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the turbine two. Understood, low priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name. Sounds like you're in trouble.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Usually means either that or someone wants my password. Bearings is the better option.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Marc, can you do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on Monday? Whenever you get a chance — no big rush round it, but Monday is the day.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor on Monday. Whenever I get a chance that day, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the coming Monday, just so we're not talking about yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, coming Monday. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Two names, two jobs. Efficient system.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same pay packet, sadly.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, I'll order spare parts for the line 3 barrel by 11am. Low priority, that one — it's just the order.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ordering only, yeah? Not fitting anything to the line 3 barrel?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, only ordering. I'll order the spare parts, no fitting work in that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Spare parts for the line 3 barrel, order by 11am, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say low priority and eleven? Just checking I heard both.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: You did, yeah. Low priority is still right; by 11am is still the deadline for the order.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you replace the seals on the boiler feed pump first thing tomorrow? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yes, I'll replace the seals on the boiler feed pump first thing tomorrow. Safety critical, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just to be clear on the wording — straight away when that first-thing-tomorrow job starts, rather than changing it to today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. First thing tomorrow stays the timing. That one's safety critical, straight away — not a job to push down the queue.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Got it. First thing tomorrow, I'll replace those seals on the boiler feed pump. No drift into later on.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And my bearings on the turbine two are still low priority alongside those safety-critical bits?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, still low priority. Nothing changed there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine. And just keeping my rattle comment out of the actions — I haven't asked for an inspection off that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, observation only. The closed inspection and that comment are separate.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Likewise, the line 2 robot hasn't somehow become another order chase for me while we've been talking?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, still the existing supplier-confirmation blocker. No new action attached to it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All right. My Northfield Substation pickup for the turbine two water valve is today at 2pm. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Callum. Safety-critical pickup, agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. And for the record, the flapjack wasn't a complaint. More of a hardness observation.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing to action yet, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Definitely not putting cake on the action list. Right, all agreed. Cheers, everyone.
